blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Deep models for radiological diagnosis are typically trained to predict disease labels directly from images, which limits them to diseases seen during training and makes their decisions hard to interpret in radiologists' terms. Radiology, however, proceeds from visual findings to disease through published guidelines that make this decision rule explicit, interpretable, and reproducible. We introduce diagnosis by composition (DbC), a representation learning framework that encodes this findings-first logic. DbC learns a vocabulary of radiological findings by aligning image features with the text embeddings of the findings, each finding represented as a dense map over the scan. A disease is defined by a set of required findings derived from its guidelines, and its diagnosis map is a fixed, parameter-free composition of the corresponding finding maps. Because the finding-to-disease mapping is derived from guidelines rather than learned, DbC is interpretable and auditable by design, can extend to new diseases by specifying their findings without retraining, and can diagnose unseen diseases by composing their findings. On multi-phase liver CT, DbC detects and localizes unseen diseases, rare diseases from a different institution, and an external cohort significantly better than all comparators, including models that align images with disease names. DbC also improves detection and localization in the fully supervised setting and remains superior across training-set sizes. Although demonstrated on liver CT, DbC applies wherever radiological guidelines define diseases through findings.
blocks.zh: 辐射诊断的深层模型一般都经过培训,可以直接从图像中预测疾病标签,从而将其限制在培训期间看到的疾病,使其决定难以用放射学家的术语解释. 然而,放射学通过公布的准则从视觉发现变为疾病,这些准则使这一决定具有明确性、可解释性和可复制性。 我们引入了通过组成(DbC)进行诊断的方法,这是一种代表学习框架,它编码了这一结论-第一逻辑。 DbC通过将图像特征与发现的文本嵌入相配合来学习放射性发现的词汇,每个发现在扫描上以密集的地图表示. 一种疾病由一套从它的准则中得出的必要结果来定义,其诊断图是对应的发现图的固定的,无参数的构成. 由于发现到病症的映射来源于准则而非学识,DbC通过设计可以解释和审计,可以通过不进行再培训而具体说明其发现,从而延伸至新疾病,并通过编集其发现来诊断看不见的疾病. 在多相肝CT中,DbC检测和定位隐形疾病,来自不同机构的罕见疾病,外部群比所有参照物强得多,包括将图像与疾病名称相匹配的模型. DbC还改进了在完全监督下的环境下的检测和本地化,在培训设置规模上仍然优越。 虽然在肝脏CT上得到证明,但DbC适用于放射性准则通过发现对疾病作出定义的地方。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Most machine learning models for radiological diagnosis are trained to predict a disease label directly from the image ( Yasaka et al., 2018 ; Hamm et al., 2019 ) . In this pattern, which we call disease-first, the disease is the unit of learning, and the visual findings a radiologist reasons about either never explicitly enter the model or are recovered from it afterwards ( Wang et al., 2019 ) . Such a model cannot explain a decision in a radiologist’s terms, and it is closed-set, with one output for each disease it was trained on. Vision-language aligned models, which bridge images with text in a shared space ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , appear to lift the closed-set limit, because a disease can be named at test time ( Hamamci et al., 2026 ; Blankemeier et al., 2026 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Rokuss et al., 2026 ) . The image is still aligned with the name of the disease, however, and recent models aligned at the finer grain of individual anatomies ( Shui et al., 2025 ) still construct representations around diagnosis targets.
blocks.zh: 大多数放射诊断的机器学习模型都经过培训,可以直接从图像中预测出疾病标签(Yasaka等,2018;Hamm等,2019. 在这个我们称之为疾病第一的模式中,疾病是学习的单位,视觉发现的放射学家理由要么从未明确进入模式,要么事后从中恢复(Wang等,2019). 这种模式不能用放射学家的术语来解释一个决定,它是封闭式的,每个疾病都有一个输出。 视觉语言对接模型,将图像与文本连接在一个共享空间(Radford等,2021年),似乎可以解除闭塞设定的限制,因为一种疾病可以在测试时命名(Hamamci等,2026年;Blankemeier等,2026年;Du等,2024年;赵等,2025年;Rokus等,2026年). 然而,该图像仍然与该疾病的名称一致,最近对单个解剖的更细粒(Shui等人,2025年)的模型仍然围绕诊断目标构建表述.

blocks.en: Radiology itself is organized the other way around, in a pattern we call findings-first. A radiologist first identifies the visual findings in a scan, properties that are directly visible such as how dense a lesion is or how it takes up contrast, and then reads the disease as the combination of findings that defines it. For most diseases that combination is tracked in published radiological guidelines ( Chernyak et al., 2018 ) , which makes the diagnosis interpretable, reproducible, and teachable. Radiologists also learn in this order, trained to identify the findings first and to reason from them to diagnose ( Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education, 2019 ; Hartung et al., 2020 ; European Society of Radiology, 2011 ; American College of Radiology, 2025 ) , which is one reason they can take on a disease they rarely encountered, usually as a new combination of findings they already recognize.
blocks.zh: 放射学本身是相反的, 我们称之为先发现。 放射学家首先在扫描中识别出视觉发现,直接可见的属性,如损伤的密度多高,或者它是如何接受对比的,然后将疾病解读为定义它的发现的组合. 对于大多数疾病,这些结合在已公布的放射指南(Chernyak等人,2018年)中跟踪,这使得诊断可以解释、可复制和可教学。 放射学家们也按照这个顺序学习,训练他们首先识别发现,然后从他们那里得到诊断的理由(医学教育研究生认证委员会,2019年;Hartung等,2020年;欧洲放射学学会,2011年;美国放射学学院,2025年),这是他们能够接受一种很少遇到的疾病的原因之一,通常作为他们已经认识的发现的新组合.

blocks.en: Here, we propose diagnosis by composition (DbC), a representation learning framework that builds this findings-first order into a model in three steps. First, the rule from findings to each disease is derived from published radiological guidelines by clinical experts on our team, who reviewed these guidelines and wrote the definitions of common liver diseases in one shared vocabulary of findings. Second, the model learns to recognize the findings by aligning image features at every location of the scan with the text embedding of each finding, supervised densely by the findings each disease requires and diversely by the further findings that reports record, with the loss computed on the findings alone. Third, at inference, a disease is diagnosed by localizing the findings its definition requires and combining the resulting finding maps with a fixed, parameter-free operation (Figure 1 b).
blocks.zh: 在此,我们建议按组成情况进行诊断(DbC),这是一个代表性学习框架,将这一结果的第一顺序分三个步骤形成一个模式。 第一,从发现到每种疾病的规则来自我们团队临床专家公布的放射准则,他们审查了这些准则并用一个共同的发现词汇来写出常见肝病的定义. 第二,该模型通过将扫描每个地点的图像特征与嵌入每个发现的文字相统一,通过报告记录的更多结果,对每种疾病进行密集监督,并采用多种不同方式来识别这些结果,而损失仅根据调查结果计算。 第三,根据推论,诊断疾病的方法是将其定义要求的发现定位,并将结果的发现地图与固定的、无参数的操作相结合(图1b)。

blocks.en: Defining diseases as compositions over a shared finding vocabulary gives the DbC model three properties by design. Because a diagnosis is a combination of named finding maps, the model is interpretable and auditable finding by finding. Because a disease is added by stating the findings it requires, the model is extensible by declaration and reaches a new disease without retraining. And because the findings a disease requires can be recognized even when the disease never appeared in training, the model is zero-shot by composition (Figure 1 a). Rigorous zero-shot experiments therefore can test whether the model has learned a reusable vocabulary of findings rather than a set of disease labels, and their results show that findings-first learning yields a more generalizable representation than disease-first learning. We make three main contributions in this work: • We introduce diagnosis by composition (DbC), a findings-first representation learning framework for radiological diagnosis that is interpretable and auditable by design and extends to diseases never seen in training. • We show that DbC localizes diseases never seen in training significantly better than every comparator, including models that align images with disease names. • We show that this advantage extends to rare diseases and external institutions, and that DbC remains significantly better than its disease-first counterpart at every training-set size.
blocks.zh: 将疾病定义为共同发现词汇的成分,从设计上赋予了DbC模型三个属性. 由于一个诊断是被命名的查找地图的结合,该模型通过查找来解释和验证. 由于一种疾病是通过说明它所需要的发现而增加的,所以该模型通过申报而可以扩展,在没有再培训的情况下到达了一种新的疾病. 而且由于一种疾病所需的发现即使在训练中从未出现过这种疾病时也能被识别出,因此模型按成分是零发(图1a). 因此,严格的零镜头实验可以测试模型是否学到了可重复使用的结论词汇,而不是一套疾病标签,其结果显示,结论-第一学习产生比疾病-第一学习更具普遍性的代表性. 我们在这项工作中作出了三个主要贡献:我们采用按组成进行的诊断(DbC),这是辐射诊断的第一结果表现学习框架,可按设计加以解释和审计,并延伸到培训中从未见过的疾病。 我们显示,DbC将培训中从未见过的疾病本地化的程度大大优于每个参照国,包括将图像与疾病名称相匹配的模型。 我们显示,这种优势扩展到罕见的疾病和外部机构,在每一次培训中,DbC仍然大大优于疾病第一对应机构。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Contrastive pretraining aligns images and text in a shared space in which a category is recognized by the embedding of its name ( Radford et al., 2021 ) . Medical vision-language aligned models learn such spaces from biomedical figures ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , chest radiographs ( Tiu et al., 2022 ) and CT volumes ( Hamamci et al., 2026 ; Blankemeier et al., 2026 ) paired with text, most often reports, at units as fine as image regions and report words ( Huang et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2022 ) , report entities ( Wu et al., 2023 ) and anatomies ( Shui et al., 2025 ) , and multimodal large language models build report generation on their image encoders ( Hamamci et al., 2026 ; Blankemeier et al., 2026 ) . Language-driven dense prediction builds on this foundation and carries the match to pixels ( Li et al., 2022 ) and to 3D medical volumes ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , and in the promptable interface of Segment Anything ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ) , SegVol ( Du et al., 2024 ) , SAT ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) and VoxTell ( Rokuss et al., 2026 ) return a region for a text prompt, even for a disease outside their training set. These dense models are the natural comparators of this work, since a lesion-level evaluation needs a map, and our matched ablation Disease-VL carries the scan-level matching of an image to a disease name down to the lesion level (Section 4.1 ). Across the family, a disease is anchored on its name or description, and the visual findings are learned only implicitly, as far as the paired text states them. Reports typically state few of the findings a lesion shows (Section 3.3 ), so what these models learn about findings is as sparse and noisy as the reports, whereas DbC supervises the findings explicitly and densely on the lesion masks from both the well-defined radiological guidelines and diverse clinical reports.
blocks.zh: 相互矛盾的预训将图像和文本放在一个共享空间中,通过嵌入其名称来确认一个类别(Radford等,2021年)。 医学视觉语言对接模型从生物医学人物(张等,2025年),胸腔放射图(Tiu等,2022年)和CT卷(Hamamci等,2026年;Blankemeier等,2026年)中学习出这样的空间,最常被报道的文本与图像区和报告单词一样精细的单位配对(黄等,2021年;Wang等,2022年),报告实体(Wu等,2023年)和解剖(Shui等,2025年),多模式大语言模型在其图像编码器上构建生成报告(Hamamci等,2026年;Blankemeier等,2026年). 语言驱动的密集预测以此为基础,并搭配了像素(Li等,2022年)和3D医疗卷(Liu等,2023年),并在Sip Anything(Kirillov等,2023年),Seg Vol(Du等,2024年),SAT(赵等,2025年)和VoxTell(Rokus等,2026年)的快速界面中,返回一个区域,以获得文本即时,即使是在训练场外的疾病. 这些密集的模型是这项工作的自然参照物,因为损害级评价需要一张地图,而我们匹配的发病-VL则将图像与疾病名称相匹配到损害级(第4.1节)。 在整个家族中,一种疾病是根植于其名称或描述之上的,而视觉发现只是隐含地学习的,只要成对地的文字予以说明. 报告通常很少提到损伤所显示的结果(第3.3节),因此这些模型了解的结果与报告一样稀少和吵闹,而DbC则从明确界定的辐射准则和各种临床报告中明确和密集地监督对损伤口罩的调查结果。

blocks.en: Concept bottleneck models predict named concepts and learn the mapping from them to each class from examples of that class ( Koh et al., 2020 ) , with the concepts later drawn from a language model or a vision-language space ( Oikarinen et al., 2023 ; Yuksekgonul et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2023 ) , so the class (i.e., diagnosis in this case) remains the anchor of learning. Diagnosis by composition shares the named intermediate layer but derives the mapping from findings to a disease from published radiological guidelines, uses a vocabulary that serves many diseases, and is evaluated on diseases the model never saw, a setting concept bottleneck models are not built for. Description-based methods score an image against language descriptions of a class ( Menon and Vondrick, 2023 ) , and in radiology Xplainer combines the scores that a pretrained vision-language aligned model gives the observations a radiologist looks for into a zero-shot diagnosis ( Pellegrini et al., 2023 ) , while CLEAR ( Han et al., 2026 ) scores an image against observations mined from reports. The descriptive terms of these methods are found in clinical reports or scored by a pretrained model rather than optimized as training targets, whereas our findings are training targets that the model learns to localize.
blocks.zh: 概念瓶颈模型预测被命名的概念,并从这些概念中从该类的例子中向每个类学习绘图(Koh等,2020年),后来的概念取自语言模型或视觉语言空间(Oikarien等,2023年;Yukekgonul等,2023年;Yang等,2023年),因此该类(即本案中的诊断)仍然是学习的支柱. 按组成进行的诊断共用了命名的中间层,但从调查结果到已公布的放射准则的疾病,使用为许多疾病服务的词汇,对模型从未见到的疾病进行评价,无法建立一种设定的概念瓶颈模型。 基于描述的方法比作某类语言描述(Menon and Vondrick, 2023)的图像得分,在放射学上,Xplaner将预先训练的视觉语言对接模型给观测结果的分数组合在一起(Pellegrini等, 2023),而CLEAR(Han等, 2026)则比从报告中挖掘出来的观测结果得分. 这些方法的描述性术语见于临床报告,或被预先训练过的模型所打分,而不是作为培训目标加以优化,而我们的调查结果是,该模型学会将培训目标本地化。

blocks.zh: 3个 按组成进行的诊断

blocks.en: 3.1 Framework and inductive bias
blocks.zh: 3.1 框架和诱导性偏见

blocks.en: Diagnosis by composition follows the two stages of radiological practice, learning to recognize the visual findings in a scan and reading a disease as the combination of findings that its guideline requires, with the rule derived from published radiological guidelines rather than learned from data.
blocks.zh: 按成份进行诊断遵循放射实践的两个阶段,学习在扫描中识别视觉发现,并读取疾病是其准则所要求的发现的组合,规则取自已公布的放射准则,而不是从数据中学习.

blocks.en: 3.2 Finding vocabulary and diagnostic compositions for liver CT
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 寻找肝脏CT的词汇和诊断成分

blocks.en: We instantiate the framework for multi-phase liver CT, where a study may contain any of four contrast phases (non-contrast, arterial, portal venous and delayed) and the model uses whichever are available. Radiologists on our team who specialize in liver imaging defined the finding vocabulary and the diagnostic compositions by reviewing published radiological guidelines and reference reviews ( Chernyak et al., 2018 ; Galle et al., 2018 ; Marrero et al., 2018 ) , with the sources for each disease listed in Appendix B . The resulting finding catalog lists the M = 40 M=40 findings of the vocabulary in twelve categories, among them density, margin and the pattern of contrast enhancement in each phase (Table 5 ). The catalog was built to cover the six common liver diseases, which are those in our internal data, and Section 4.4 tests its robustness on two rare diseases beyond them.

blocks.en: A diagnostic composition is the definition of a disease derived from its guidelines and written in this vocabulary, the findings that the disease most typically shows and that must all be present. Through the soft minimum it is at once the clinical definition of the disease and the rule the model evaluates, for a seen disease and an unseen one alike, and it also labels every training lesion of the disease (Section 3.3 ). Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), for example, typically requires low density on the non-contrast phase, non-rim arterial hyperenhancement, non-peripheral washout and an enhancing capsule, and each of the seven diagnoses we model requires two to five findings (Table 6 ). The compositions share findings, so one vocabulary serves every disease and a finding such as low density is supervised by the lesions of every disease that requires it (Figure 4 ).
blocks.zh: 诊断成分是指一种疾病的定义取自其准则并用这个词汇书写,该疾病最典型的显示结果,必须全部存在. 通过最低程度的软度,它立即成为该疾病的临床定义和模型评价的规则,对于一种可见和看不见的疾病,它也标出该疾病的每一个训练损伤(第3.3节)。 例如,肝细胞癌(HCC),一般要求非相接相的密度低,非相环动脉增高,非腹部冲洗和增强胶囊,我们模型的七个诊断都要求2到5个发现(表6). 组成成分分享结果,因此一种词汇为每一种疾病服务,一种诸如低密度的发现则由每种需要它的疾病的损伤所监督(图4)。

blocks.en: 3.3 Finding supervision from guidelines and reports
blocks.zh: 3.3 从准则和报告中寻找监督

blocks.en:
Each training lesion is labeled with findings from three complementary sources, which its mask places on the token grid (Appendix C ). First, every lesion receives a set of required findings of its disease, derived from the radiological guidelines by clinical experts on our team, whether or not its report mentions them. The required findings give each disease a fixed composition grounded in authoritative clinical knowledge, but they also give every lesion of the disease the same findings, whereas the realistic mapping between findings and diseases is not deterministic and a lesion may show findings that are not typical of its disease (intra-disease variation). Thus, the second source of findings is the report, long mined for labels ( Irvin et al., 2019 ; Jain et al., 2021 ; Adams et al., 2023 ) , which captures this diversity. Qwen3-Max ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) is used to extract the supportive findings of each lesion, the catalog findings that its report records beyond the required ones. Extraction from reports alone would not produce a high-quality set of findings, however, since radiologists seldom report the complete set of visual findings they observe. In our data, a lesion is associated with only about 1.2 radiological findings on average in the findings section of CT reports, too sparse a signal to learn a vocabulary of findings from, which largely limits models supervised by reports alone (Section 2 ).
The guideline-derived required findings thus make the supervision dense, and the report-extracted supportive findings make it diverse. Lastly, each lesion also receives one of four size findings , derived from its mask dimensions. All three types of finding labels train the finding maps of each lesion, but only the required findings form the diagnostic composition used at inference.

每个训练损伤都带有三个补充来源的发现,其口罩被贴入了标志网格(附录C)。 第一,每个损伤都收到一系列必要的病因调查结果,这些调查结果来自我们团队临床专家的放射准则,而不论其报告是否提及。 必要的调查结果使每种疾病都具有基于权威临床知识的固定成分,但是它们也使疾病的每一处损伤都得到同样的发现,而现实地将发现与疾病相挂钩并不是决定性的,而一种损伤可能显示出与其疾病并不典型的发现(疾病内部变化)。 因此,第二个调查结果来源是长期被打入标签的报告(Irvin等人,2019年;Jain等人,2021年;Adams等人,2023年)。 Qune3-Max(Quen Team,2025)用于提取每起损伤的辅助结论,其报告记录的目录结论超出了要求. 然而,仅仅从报告中提取资料并不能产生一套高质量的调查结果,因为放射学家很少报告他们观察到的整套可视调查结果。 在我们的数据中,损伤仅与CT报告的结论部分中平均约1.2个放射性发现有关,信号太少,无法从中学习结论词汇,这在很大程度上限制了仅由报告监督的模型(第2节)。
因此,从准则中得出的必要结果使监督工作变得密集,而从报告中摘出的支持性结果则使之多样化。 最后,每个损伤还收到来自其口罩尺寸的四分之一的检测结果。 所有三种寻找标签都训练每个损伤的查找图,但只有必要的发现构成推断时使用的诊断成分.

blocks.en: In the model that predicts the finding maps (Figure 2 ), a four-channel SwinUNETR encoder ( Hatamizadeh et al., 2022 ; He et al., 2023 ) reads the available contrast phases of a CT together, with an all-zero channel for any phase that was not acquired (Appendix A ), and its dense output is projected and flattened to one embedding v n v_{n} per token n n . Each finding is represented by its name, placed in a fixed prompt and encoded once by a frozen BiomedCLIP text encoder ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) into a text embedding t m t_{m} , which a small learned adapter ϕ \phi maps into the space of the token embeddings. The cosine similarity of v n v_{n} and ϕ ⁡ ( t m ) \phi(t_{m}) , rescaled by a learned scale s m s_{m} and bias b m b_{m} for each finding and passed through a sigmoid, gives the probability of finding m m at token n n , a m ​ n = σ ⁡ ( s m ​ v n ⊤ ​ ϕ ​ ( t m ) ∥ v n ∥ 2 ​ ∥ ϕ ⁡ ( t m ) ∥ 2 + b m ) , a_{mn}=\sigma\!\left(s_{m}\,\frac{v_{n}^{\top}\phi(t_{m})}{\lVert v_{n}\rVert_{2}\,\lVert\phi(t_{m})\rVert_{2}}+b_{m}\right), (2) so each finding map is produced the way a vision-language aligned model recognizes a category, by matching image features to the text embedding of its name ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , here at every token and trained with dense labels rather than image-text pairs. blocks.en: We curated 15,609 multi-phase liver CTs with lesion masks and radiology reports from a single institution, split at the patient level into 12,487 training, 1,559 validation and 1,563 test CTs (Appendix A ). Each CT may carry one or more of six liver diseases, hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (ICC), metastasis, hemangioma, focal nodular hyperplasia (FNH) and cyst. Calcification is a minor additional label that also enters the macro averages, and a CT with no lesion is a negative. Every experiment selects checkpoints on the validation split.

blocks.en: We evaluate detection, whether a disease is present, and localization, where its lesions are, for every disease and as a macro mean over diseases (Appendix F ). Detection is scored per CT by AUROC, average precision (AP) and sensitivity at 95% specificity, and localization per lesion by the Dice, IoU and coverage of the best-matching predicted lesion and by mask average precision at IoU ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 (AP 50 ) ( Lin et al., 2014 ) . Every metric is reported with a 95% confidence interval from a CT-level bootstrap with 2,000 replicates, in which every model receives the same resampled CTs, and one model is significantly better than another when the interval of their paired difference lies above zero.
blocks.zh: 我们评价一种疾病的检测,是否存在,以及其病情的发生地点,对每一种疾病以及相对于疾病的宏观含义(附录F)。 AUROC每CT检测得分,平均精度(AP)和灵敏度为95%的特异性,而Dice、IoU和最相配的预测损伤的覆盖率和IoU 0.5\geq 0.5(AP 50)的口罩平均精度(Lin等人,2014年)。 每一个度量衡都以95%的置信间隔从一个有2000个复制机的CT级靴子上报告,其中每个模型都得到相同的重印CT,当其配对相差相差超过零时,一个模型明显优于另一个模型.

blocks.en: We train and evaluate under two regimes. In the supervised regime the model was trained on the disease it is asked to diagnose, and in the zero-shot regime it received no supervision for that disease and saw no CT that contains it. We create the zero-shot regime by leave-one-disease-out (LODO) , removing from training and eval every CT that carries a given disease and training a separate model on the rest, so that this disease is unseen and the others are seen . • Fully supervised (supervised, internal, Section 4.2 ). Every model is trained on the full training data and scored on the 1,563 internal test CTs. • Unseen diseases (zero-shot, internal, Section 4.3 ). Each of the six diseases is made unseen in turn by LODO and scored on its test CTs against those without it. • Rare diseases from a different institution (zero-shot, external, Section 4.4 ). Abscess and hepatoblastoma, two rare liver diseases outside our taxonomy and in no split, are scored from the fully supervised checkpoint against CTs without a liver lesion (Appendix G ). • External transfer (both regimes, external, Section 4.4 ). The public MCT-LTDiag cohort ( Wu et al., 2026 ) holds four diseases from our taxonomy (Appendix G ), each scored from the fully supervised checkpoint, which trained on the four, and from their respective LODO checkpoints, which did not. • Data scaling (supervised, internal, Section 4.5 ). DbC and Disease-VL are repeatedly and independently trained on nested subsets of 10˜100% of the train set with three seeds each.

blocks.en: Every comparator is trained on the same CTs, splits and compute as DbC under the same protocol, with its checkpoint selected on the same validation split, so that only the design differs. We aim for comparator models on lesion-level detection and localization, since it not only closely matches our modeling setup, but also demonstrates how precisely a learned representation is grounded in local visual evidence, which is an important test of its quality. • Matched ablations (disease-first, on the encoder of DbC). Disease-VL and Disease-V share the image encoder, input, loss and optimizer of DbC but predict disease maps directly instead of composing them from findings, isolating the effect of learning findings-first. Disease-VL aligns the same model with disease names instead of finding names, so it can be prompted with unseen diseases. Disease-V drops the language arm, a closed-set vision-only control that appears only in the supervised comparison. • Published baselines (disease-first vision-language aligned models). SegVol ( Du et al., 2024 ) , SAT ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) and VoxTell ( Rokuss et al., 2026 ) return a region for a text prompt, and each is fine-tuned from its released checkpoint on our data (Appendix E ).

blocks.en: 4.2 Fully supervised diagnosis

blocks.en: With every disease supervised, composing diagnoses from findings does not cost accuracy and in fact improves it. DbC is the best of the six systems on every localization and detection metric, and its detection is significantly better than every comparator (AUROC, Table 1 ). Because DbC also improves on its two matched ablations under identical data and compute, the gain comes from composing findings rather than from the encoder or the architecture. These results suggest that findings-first learning produces a better representation in the setting where every evaluated disease is supervised during training.

blocks.en: 4.3 Unseen diseases by composition
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 按组成分列的未见病

blocks.en: DbC and every comparator in Table 2 are vision-language aligned models, and all of them reach an unseen disease through the principle that lets CLIP recognize categories it was never trained on ( Radford et al., 2021 ) . CLIP embeds images and text in a shared space and recognizes a category by matching an image to the text embedding of its name, so that in a well-aligned space an image of a new category lands near its name although the two were never paired. The models compared here make this match at every location, producing a map rather than a single score, and none is retrained for the unseen disease. What differs between them is the text that the image is matched with, the anchors of Figure 1 a. A disease-first model matches image features with the embedding of the name of the unseen disease, while DbC matches them with the embeddings of its required findings and composes the resulting maps with the soft minimum. For DbC, every disease has some required findings that belong to no other disease (required or supportive), so every LODO run asks it to zero-shot localize at least one required finding with no direct supervision to compose.
blocks.zh: DbC和表2中的每一个参照者都是视觉语言的对等模型,它们都通过让CLIP承认从未受过训练的类别的原则(Radford等,2021年),达到一种看不见的疾病. CLIP将图像和文本嵌入到一个共享的空间中,并通过将图像与嵌入其名称的文本相匹配来识别一个类别,这样,在一个紧密相通的空间中,一个新类别的图像会在其名称附近着陆,尽管两者从未对齐. 这里比较的模型使这种匹配 在每个地点, 制作一个地图而不是一个分数, 没有一个被重新训练 对于看不见的疾病。 两者的不同之处在于图像所匹配的文本,即图1a的锚. 疾病第一模型将图像特征与隐形疾病名称的嵌入相匹配,而DbC则将图像特征与它所要求的发现的嵌入相匹配,并用最软的最小度来绘制所产生的地图. 对DbC来说,每一种疾病都有一些不属于其他疾病(需要或支持)的必要发现,因此每个LODO运行都要求它至少将一个需要的发现本地化,而没有直接监督来作曲.

blocks.en: Two intuitions may help explain why aligning the image with findings transfers where aligning it with disease names does not. Disease names may carry clinical meaning more than visual evidence, whereas findings name what is visible. The relations among finding terms in the language space may also mirror how the findings relate in appearance more closely than the relations among disease names do, which would give the image features a clearer structure to align with. If “delayed central scar enhancement” were unseen while “progressive delayed enhancement” and “central scar” were seen, for example, a model aligned with the latter two could plausibly match the new phrase to the right image regions, whereas a disease-first model trained on “hepatocellular carcinoma” and “cholangiocarcinoma” may find it harder to localize a lesion prompted as “metastasis”.
blocks.zh: 两种直觉可以帮助解释,如果图像与疾病名称不相符,为什么图像与结果转移不相一致。 疾病名称可能包含临床意义,而不是视觉证据,而发现名称则是可见的. 语言空间中搜索术语之间的关系也可能反映发现在外观上的关系比疾病名称之间的关系更密切,这将使图像特征具有更清晰的结构与之相配合。 例如,如果在看到“渐进性延迟增强”和“中伤”的同时,看不到“延迟中伤增强”的情况,那么与后两种模式相一致的模型就有可能将新词语与正确的图像区域相匹配,而首先接受过“肝细胞癌”和“胆干细胞癌”培训的疾病模型则可能发现难以将“致病”引起的损伤定位。

blocks.en: The rare-disease experiment is harder than internal leave-one-disease-out in two ways. Two diseases are withheld at once, and because our finding catalog was built only for the six internal diseases (Section 3.2 ), it also tests whether the catalog and its compositions reach diseases they were never designed for. The radiologists on our team defined each composition from published imaging criteria, as for the internal diseases and with no reference to the model or its outputs (Table 6 ). Evaluated on the checkpoint trained on the internal diseases, which never saw either disease, DbC is significantly better than every comparator on every metric for both rare diseases (Table 3 ). Moreover, on the public external MCT-LTDiag cohort, DbC is significantly better than every comparator in both regimes at localizing the lesions and at telling the diseases apart (Table 4 , Appendix H ). These results further support the robustness and generalizability of the DbC framework.

blocks.en: A final experiment scales the training data. DbC and its disease-first ablation Disease-VL are trained on nested subsets of the training data, each containing all diseases. At every fraction, each model is trained three times independently, with seeds 42, 43 and 44 setting both the sampled subset and the initialization, and every run is scored on the same internal test set (Figure 3 ). Both improve as the data grows, and DbC is significantly better than Disease-VL at almost every fraction across all diagnoses. This advantage, consistent over the three runs at every fraction, shows that the DbC framework scales with data. The relative gain is largest at the smallest fraction, which fits the view that supervising findings across diseases uses the data more efficiently than supervising diseases.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: The results of Section 4 can be read through the clinical order that DbC builds in. Radiologists first learn to recognize findings and then read each disease as the combination of findings that its guidelines define, and DbC learns in the same order. A radiologist recognizes a rarely seen disease as a new combination of familiar findings, and DbC likewise composes an unseen or rare disease from findings learned on other diseases, localizing such diseases significantly better than every comparator. Findings describe what is visible and recur across diseases and institutions, which fits the transfer of the same representation to an external cohort. Every labeled lesion also supervises findings that several diseases share, so the same data inform many diagnoses at once, and DbC is better than its disease-first counterpart at every training-set size, most of all when data are scarce. Each of these advantages is measured side by side with the matched ablations, which isolate composing as their source. Read as representation learning, which we offer as a hypothesized interpretation, the results fit the view that a reusable vocabulary of findings generalizes better than a set of disease labels. The same view suggests that DbC should improve as more diseases and findings are incorporated in training, since each added disease supervises its findings on new lesions, much as a radiologist’s expertise grows with every disease learned.
blocks.zh: 第4节的结果可以通过DbC所构建的临床顺序来读取. 放射学家首先学习识别发现,然后将每种疾病读作它的准则所定义的发现的组合,而DbC学习顺序相同. 一位放射学家承认很少看到一种疾病是熟悉的发现的新组合,而DbC同样从对其他疾病的发现中构成一种看不见或罕见的疾病,使这种疾病本地化的程度大大好于每个比较国。 调查结果描述了在各种疾病和机构中可见和反复出现的情况,这符合将同一代表性转移给外部群体的做法。 每个被贴上标签的病症也监督着几种疾病共享的发现,因此同一数据同时为许多诊断提供信息,而DbC在每一个训练设置的大小上都优于其疾病第一对应,尤其是在数据稀缺的情况下. 每一个优点都与相匹配的擦伤相并用,这些擦伤将编织物孤立为源头。 读作代表性学习,我们提供一种假设性的解释,结果符合一种观点,即可重复使用的结论词汇比一套疾病标签更为概括。 同一观点认为,随着更多的疾病和调查结果被纳入培训之中,DbC应该有所改进,因为每一增加的疾病都监督其对新发病的发现,而放射学家的专业知识随着所学出每种疾病而增加。

blocks.en: A findings-first model is interpretable because its explanation is the computation itself, a diagnosis composed from named finding maps that a radiologist can check finding by finding. Figure 6 shows such maps on test CTs, where each composed map follows the findings specific to its disease. Such an interpretable and auditable representation may also serve generative models on CT. Multimodal large language models (LLMs) that write reports or answer clinical questions are commonly built on the image encoder of a vision-language aligned model ( Hamamci et al., 2026 ; Blankemeier et al., 2026 ) , and the generalizable representation that DbC learns by aligning images with findings could serve as such an encoder. A report states the findings before the impression they support, the order in which DbC reaches a diagnosis, so an LLM conditioned on the finding maps could generate clinical reports with localized finding maps, which will likely make the reports more visually faithful and verifiable. LLM reasoning could likewise build on the finding maps, an intermediate more granular than a disease label and grounded in the image, and we leave these extensions to future work.
blocks.zh: 一个发现-第一模型可以解释,因为它的解释是计算本身,由命名的发现地图组成的诊断,放射学家可以通过发现来检查发现. 图6在测试的CT上显示这种地图,其中每个由地图组成的地图都遵循其疾病特有的调查结果。 这种可解释和可审计的表述也可为CT上的遗传模型服务。 撰写报告或回答临床问题的多模式大语言模型(LLMS)通常建立在视觉语言对接模型的图像编码器上(Hamamci等,2026;Blankemeier等,2026),DbC通过将图像与发现对接而学习的通俗表述可以起到这样的编码器的作用. 一份报告在他们所支持的印象之前说明了调查结果,即DbC得到诊断的顺序,因此以发现地图为条件的LLM可以生成带有局部发现地图的临床报告,这有可能使报告在视觉上更加忠实和可核查. LLM推理也可以建立在发现地图上,这个中间点比疾病标签更颗粒,并以图像为基础,我们把这些延伸留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: This study has two main limitations. First, results are shown on 3D CTs for liver disease, with training data from a single institution and seven diagnoses. The framework itself is not specific to the liver, however. Most radiological diagnosis is guideline-based, so DbC can extend to other organs and diseases through a broader catalog of named findings and disease compositions, without changing the model, and we hope these results encourage further work to apply diagnosis by composition as an interpretable and auditable scheme beyond the liver. The second concerns the compositions, which experts derive from published guidelines and which require all of their findings. They label every lesion of a disease with the findings the disease typically shows, the reports add the further findings that radiologists recorded, and the finding labels of a lesion are therefore as complete as these two sources. Though combining them already supervises findings more densely and diversely than reports or medical terminologies alone (the sources of much prior work), richer composition rules could follow atypical presentations more closely still.
blocks.zh: 这项研究有两个主要局限。 首先,在肝脏疾病的3D CT上显示结果,培训数据来自单一机构,并有7个诊断结果。 然而,框架本身并不针对肝脏。 大多数放射性诊断都是以准则为基础的,因此DbC可以通过一个更广泛的命名结果和疾病成分目录来延伸至其他器官和疾病,而不改变模型,我们希望这些结果能鼓励进一步的工作,通过组成来应用诊断作为肝脏以外的可解释和可审计的计划. 第二点涉及专家的组成,这些组成来自已公布的准则,需要他们的所有调查结果。 他们将疾病的每一处损伤都与通常显示的疾病结果相标出,报告增加了放射学家记录的更多结果,因此发现的损伤标签与这两个来源一样完整. 虽然将它们结合起来已经比仅是报告或医学术语(许多以前工作的来源)更密集和多样地监督了调查结果,但较丰富的组成规则可以更密切地遵循非典型的表述。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Radiologists name what they see before they name the disease, and published radiological guidelines define each disease as a combination of what can be seen. Diagnosis by composition builds that order into a model that learns a vocabulary of findings by aligning image features with their text embeddings and derives the finding-to-disease rule from the guidelines. On multi-phase liver CT, the model is interpretable and auditable by design, and composing diagnoses from findings is better than predicting them directly at every training-set size and significantly better than every comparator for diseases with no training examples, including rare diseases from a different institution.
blocks.zh: 放射学家在给疾病取名之前就给出了所见所闻的名字,并出版的放射指南将每一种疾病定义为能被看到的东西的组合. 按组成情况进行的诊断将这一顺序构建成一个模型,通过使图像特征与其文本嵌入一致来学习发现的词汇,并从准则中得出发现到疾病的规则。 在多相肝脏CT中,模型可按设计加以解释和审计,从结果中得出的诊断比在每一次培训中直接预测要好,而且比每个没有培训实例的疾病(包括不同机构的罕见疾病)比较者要好得多。

blocks.en: Appendix A Data and preprocessing
blocks.zh: 附录A 数据和预处理

blocks.en: We curated 15,609 multi-phase liver CTs with lesion masks and radiology reports from a single institution. A lesion mask labels each lesion with one disease of the taxonomy, and CTs without any lesion of the taxonomy supply dense negatives. The masks also carry two catch-all lesion classes, other malignant and other benign, that have no composition. Lesions of these two classes contribute supportive and size findings to the finding maps but no required findings.
blocks.zh: 我们为15 609个多相肝脏CT 配有损伤口罩和单一机构的放射报告。 一种损伤口罩将每个损伤都贴上分类学一种疾病的标签,CT则没有任何损伤分类学供应的密集阴性. 口罩还搭载了两个包罗万象的损伤类,其他恶性和其他良性,没有成分. 这两个类的省略有助于发现地图,但无必要结果。

Volumes are resampled to 0.75 × 0.75 × 5.0 0.75\times 0.75\times 5.0 mm, clipped to [ − 75,250 ] [-75,250] HU, scaled to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] and cropped around the liver to 384 × 288 × 64 384\times 288\times 64 voxels, and lesion instances are the 6-connected components of each disease mask. The token grid is 96 × 72 × 16 96\times 72\times 16 , so N = 110,592 N=110{,}592 , with 4 × 4 × 4 4\times 4\times 4 voxels ( 3 × 3 × 20 3\times 3\times 20 mm) per token. blocks.en:
The 15,609 CTs are frozen into 12,487 training, 1,559 validation and 1,563 test CTs by a patient-level 80/10/10 split with seed 42, stratified by the rarest admitted disease present in each CT with a separate stratum for CTs without lesions.
Of the 1,563 test CTs, 533 carry lesions of the taxonomy, with 2,571 lesions in total, and localization metrics are computed over these CTs.

blocks.en: Radiologists on our team who specialize in liver imaging defined the catalog and derived each diagnostic composition from published radiological guidelines and imaging references. The composition of hepatocellular carcinoma is derived from LI-RADS and the EASL and AASLD guidelines [ Chernyak et al., 2018 , Galle et al., 2018 , Marrero et al., 2018 ] , and that of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma from the EASL-ILCA guideline and society imaging references [ Alvaro et al., 2023 , Marks et al., 2025 , Kierans et al., 2025 ] . The compositions of metastasis, hemangioma, focal nodular hyperplasia and simple cyst are derived from the ACG focal-liver-lesion guideline [ Frenette et al., 2024 ] , with the LI-RADS criteria for malignancy other than hepatocellular carcinoma (LR-M) as a further source for metastasis [ American College of Radiology, 2018 ] and the EASL benign-tumor and cystic-disease guidelines and a current imaging review for the three benign entities [ European Association for the Study of the Liver, 2016 , Drenth et al., 2022 , Govardhan et al., 2026 ] .

blocks.en: Figure 5 illustrates the extraction of supportive findings. For every CT and each disease that both its mask and its report carry, Qwen3-Max [ Qwen Team, 2025 ] receives the fixed catalog and compositions (Appendix B ) with the findings and impression sections of the report, and returns in a fixed schema the catalog findings that the report supports, excluding the required findings of the disease and the size findings, with the report phrase behind each. A radiologist on our team reviewed a random sample of 200 extractions and found all of them faithful to the source report. The finding labels of each lesion instance are then assembled deterministically from the required findings of its disease, the supportive findings of its CT and disease pair, and one size finding derived from the mask dimensions. For a lesion whose disease the report does not mention, the supportive layer is dropped and the lesion keeps its required and size findings only. The extraction never changes a diagnostic composition used at inference time, which is solely defined by the required findings for each disease.

blocks.en: The finding labels of every lesion instance are rasterized to the 96 × 72 × 16 96\times 72\times 16 token grid. For every token and every disease with at least one voxel in the token, the token is assigned the lesion instance of that disease that holds the majority of its voxels, and all findings of that instance are set positive. A token touched by lesions of two diseases receives the findings of both. Low density on the non-contrast phase implies low density, a finding tied to a contrast phase is supervised only on CTs where that phase was acquired (Table 5 ), and tokens outside the liver remain all-zero and are used as hard negatives. The disease masks themselves, rasterized on the same grid with the same rule, are the training targets of Disease-VL, Disease-V and the published baselines, so every system is scored against the same token-level ground truth.

Training batches are drawn from the training split with replacement, about half lesion-bearing and half lesion-free. Each lesion-bearing CT is assigned to the rarest disease it contains and drawn with weight proportional to q − 1 / 2 q^{-1/2} , where q q is the number of training CTs assigned to that disease, so each disease is drawn in proportion to q \sqrt{q} rather than q q .

blocks.en: For an unseen disease k k , every CT whose mask contains k k is removed from training and validation, and every other CT keeps its split assignment. Each model is trained with its usual recipe. For Disease-VL, Disease-V and the published baselines the output channel of k k is also removed from the loss, so each can still be prompted with the name of k k at test time. The positives of the test cohort of k k are the removed CTs plus what’s already in the held-out test set, and its negatives are all CTs of the fixed test split that do not carry k k , whatever their contrast phases.
blocks.zh: 对于一个看不见的疾病kk,每个口罩有kk的CT都被从训练和验证中去除,而其他每个CT则保留分出的任务. 每个模型都接受过通常的食谱训练。 对于"疾病-VL","疾病-V"和所公布的基线,Kk的输出通道也被从损失中去除,因此在测试时间仍然可以以kk的名称来催取每个通道. Kk测试组的正数是被移除的 CT 加上已经搁置的测试组的正数, 其负数都是固定测试分数的 CT , 不带 kk , 不管它们的对比相。

blocks.en: For each seed, every stratum of the training split (rarest disease present, with or without contrast) is shuffled once, and a fraction keeps a prefix of each stratum, so that smaller fractions are nested in larger ones. Seeds 42, 43 and 44 set both the subset and the initialization, the validation and test splits are unchanged, and all other settings follow Table 7 .

blocks.en: Each published baseline starts from its released checkpoint and is fine-tuned on native-resolution voxel masks of our training data with its published recipe and seed 42, for the same number of optimizer steps as the DbC run of the same setting. Its text encoder and prompt embeddings are frozen, and its checkpoint is selected by validation macro token AP.
blocks.zh: 每个公布的基线都从其公布的检查站开始,并用公布的食谱和42号种子对我国培训数据的本地解毒口罩进行微调,用于与DbC运行同一环境的相同数量的最佳步骤。 其文本编码器和即时嵌入被冻结,其检查点通过验证宏令牌AP选择.

blocks.en: Appendix E Comparator adaptation
blocks.zh: 附录E 比较器适应

blocks.en: SegVol, SAT and VoxTell are wrapped so that each returns one full-resolution map per disease from the four-phase input, and the maps are max-pooled to the token grid, since a ground-truth token is positive when any of its voxels is. Every model is prompted with plain clinical names, namely hepatocellular carcinoma, intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, liver metastasis, hepatic hemangioma, focal nodular hyperplasia of the liver, hepatic cyst and liver calcification, and abscess and hepatoblastoma for the rare diseases. The one-channel input layer of each model is extended to the four phases by repeating its weights and dividing by four, which preserves the pretrained response when the phases are identical, and each phase is normalized with the model’s own rule. SegVol is used with text prompts only and resized to its fixed input shape, SAT in its released Nano configuration with its BioLORD text embeddings, and VoxTell as the full text-conditioned model with its positional encoding adapted to our crop.
blocks.zh: SegVol,SAT和VoxTell都被包裹了起来,这样每个都从四相输入中返回每个疾病一个全分辨率的地图,地图被最大地集合到符号网格上,因为当一个地真符号的任何阴性符号是正的. 每一个模型都带有简单的临床名称,即肝细胞癌、肝内胆固醇癌、肝元化、肝外出血、肝分泌性肝增生、肝囊肿和肝钙化、罕见疾病发作和肝溃疡。 每个模型的一通道输入层通过重复其重量并被除以4来被扩展至四个相,这在相片完全相同时保留了预受训练的响应,每个相片都与模型自己的规则正常化. SegVol只使用文本提示并调整到固定输入形状,SAT在其发布的Nano配置中使用其BioLORD文本嵌入,而VoxTell作为文本条件完整的模型,其位置编码适应了我们的收成.

blocks.en: Appendix F Metric definitions and bootstrap
blocks.zh: 附录F 计量定义和靴子

blocks.en: Every system supplies one map per disease on the token grid, namely the composed diagnosis map for DbC, the sigmoid of the direct channel for Disease-VL and Disease-V, and the max-pooled sigmoid of the native logits for the published baselines. The CT score of a disease is the maximum of its map, and the CT label is one when the CT holds a ground-truth lesion of that disease.
blocks.zh: 每个系统都提供一枚标本网格上的每发疾病分布图,即DbC的由组成的诊断图,疾病-VL和疾病-V的直通道的 sigmoid,以及已公布基线的最多集合的原生日志 sigmoid. 一种疾病的CT分数是其地图上的最大分数,当CT持有该疾病的地真损伤时,CT分数是CT分数.

blocks.en: AUROC and AP are computed over CTs, and sensitivity at 95% specificity uses as threshold the 0.95 quantile of the negative CT scores. A disease without positives or negatives is excluded from the macro mean.
blocks.zh: AUROC和AP通过CT计算,95%的特异性作为负CT分数0.95的阈值。 无阳性或负性疾病被排除在宏观平均值之外。

blocks.en: The predicted lesions are the 6-connected components of the thresholded map. Each ground-truth lesion takes the IoU, Dice and coverage (the covered fraction of the lesion) of the overlapping predicted component with the largest IoU, a lesion without an overlapping component scores zero, and values are averaged over lesions. AP 50 ranks the components formed at score 0.005 by their maximum score, matches them greedily within each CT to ground-truth lesions at IoU ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 , and integrates the precision-recall curve as in the COCO evaluation code [ Lin et al., 2014 ] .
blocks.zh: 所预测的损伤是阈值图中由6个相接的部分. 每一次地面-真实损害都涉及IoU、Dice和覆盖(损害的覆盖部分),其中最大的IoU是重叠的预测成分,没有重叠成分的损伤得分为零,其数值平均值大于损伤。 AP 50将积分为0.005的成份按最高得分排序,在IoU = 0.5\geq 0.5时,将每CT内部贪婪地将成份与地面真实损伤相匹配,并结合COCO评价码中的精准回召曲线[Lin等,2014].

blocks.en: A macro value is the unweighted mean over diseases, recomputed in every bootstrap replicate. The bootstrap draws 2,000 CT-level replicates, in which the lesions of a CT move with it and every system receives the same CTs, and the 95% interval is the percentile interval [ Efron and Tibshirani, 1993 ] . Significance is read from the interval of the paired difference between two systems, never from the overlap of their intervals. In data scaling every seed is scored on the same test CTs, a curve value is the mean over the three seeds with their standard deviation, and significance comes from the bootstrap of the seed mean (Table 10 ). On MCT-LTDiag every CT carries one of the four diseases, so the negatives of a disease are the CTs of the other three diseases, and macro values are over the four diseases.

blocks.en:
The public source [ Wu et al., 2026 ] holds four-phase CT studies of five tumor subtypes, one per study and none below 1 cm, and its colorectal and breast cancer metastases are merged into metastasis. The source registers the non-contrast, arterial and delayed volumes to the portal venous phase with B-spline registration in elastix [ Klein et al., 2010 ] , and its tumor masks are automated outputs corrected by a senior radiologist. The internal preprocessing (resampling, crop, window, connected components, rasterization) is applied unchanged, without the internal registration step. A source audit admits 482 CTs with 2,169 lesions (HCC 91 CTs with 191 lesions, ICC 81 with 286, metastasis 216 with 1,240, hemangioma 94 with 452).
MCT-LTDiag is test-only. No weight or prompt was ever fit on it.
blocks.zh:
公源 [Wu等,2026年]对5个肿瘤亚型进行了四相CT研究,每个研究1个,1厘米以下无1个,其色谱和乳腺癌元素被合并为元素. 来源在elastix[Klein等,2010年]中将非相干,动脉和延迟卷入出入口的阴道相进行B-spline注册,其肿瘤口罩由高级放射学家自动校正. 内部预处理(再取样,收成,窗口,相接部件,光栅化)应用不变,没有内部注册步骤. 来源审计承认有482个CT有2,169个损伤(HCC 91 CT有191个损伤;ICC 81有286个损伤;matastasis 216有1,240个损伤;hemangioma 94有452个损伤)。

blocks.en: The abscess and hepatoblastoma studies and the lesion-free controls come from a different institution than the internal cohort, and neither disease appears in the internal training, validation or test data. Studies with the required contrast phases (arterial for abscess, arterial and portal venous for hepatoblastoma) are processed with the internal geometry and window and gated against the internal training split on liver extent, liver fraction in the crop and per-phase intensity statistics, which leaves 176 abscess studies, 43 hepatoblastoma studies and 119 lesion-free controls. Every model answers from its full-training-data checkpoint. DbC evaluates the compositions of Table 6 , and the other models are prompted with the disease name.
blocks.zh: 脓肿和肝上腺素瘤研究以及无损伤控制都来自不同于内部组别的机构,在内部训练、鉴定或测试数据中均未出现疾病。 具有所需对比阶段的研究(血栓、动脉和肝上腺瘤出血口的血栓)用内部几何和窗口进行处理,并与肝脏范围、作物中肝分量和每相位强度统计的内部训练相适应,这些研究留下了176个血栓研究、43个肝上腺瘤研究和119个无损伤控制。 每个模型都从它的全面训练数据检查站得到答案. DbC评价表6的构成,其他模型则以疾病名来催取.

blocks.en: Figure 6 shows the composition on six CTs from the test set, one per disease, each with a coexisting lesion of another disease on the same slice. Findings shared between compositions, such as low density, are active on both lesions, while the findings specific to the target disease are active on the target lesion only, and the soft minimum follows them, so a lesion that shares some findings with the target disease but lacks the others is not composed into it.
blocks.zh: 图6显示测试组的6个CT的构成,每个疾病1个,每个疾病在同一片地同时发生另一疾病的损伤。 不同成分之间共享的发现,如低密度,在两种损伤上都很活泼,而目标疾病特有的发现只在目标损伤上活泼,而软度最低的则随之而来,因此与目标疾病共享一些发现但缺乏其他发现的损伤并不构成.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Composition on six CTs from the test set, shown on one arterial-phase slice each, where every case has a coexisting lesion of another disease. Each row shows the CT with the ground truth outlined in orange for the target disease and in green for the coexisting disease, the finding maps of the required findings of the target disease as a blue overlay (probability 0 to 1), and the composed diagnosis map. In row 1, metastasis with hemangioma, low density is active on both lesions, the findings specific to metastasis (rim arterial enhancement, peripheral washout, ill-defined margin) are active on the metastasis, and the composed map follows them. In row 4, hemangioma with ICC, low density covers both lesions, the enhancement findings specific to hemangioma cover the hemangioma only, and the composed map excludes the ICC. In row 6, cyst with hemangioma, water density, no arterial enhancement and homogeneous density separate the cyst from the hemangioma although well-defined margin and round or oval shape are active on both, and the composed map excludes the hemangioma.
blocks.zh: 图6:试验集中六个CT的构成情况,显示在一个动脉相片上,每个病例都同时出现另一种疾病的损伤。 每行显示以橙色为对象的疾病和以绿色为对象的共存疾病的CT,将目标疾病的所需结果作为蓝色覆盖图(概率为0至1)的搜索图,以及由组成的诊断图. 在第1行中,与肝脏瘤的元化反应,这两种损伤的密度都活性较低,元化反应的特有发现(边缘动脉增强,外出冲洗,边距界定不清)活性在元化反应上,由构成的地圖也随之而来. 在第4行中,与电算中心有关的血红外线瘤,密度低,既包括损伤,又包括血红外线瘤特有的增强结果,仅包括血红外线瘤,而构成的地图不包括电算中心。 在第6行中,囊肿与肝外瘤、水密度、没有动脉增强和同质密度将囊肿与肝外瘤分开,尽管明确界定的比值和圆形或椭圆形两者均活性,而构成的地图不包括肝外瘤。
